A.BEFORE_GR_DATE AS BEFORE_GR_DATE, A.PO_NO AS PO_NO, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, A.MAKER_NAME AS MAKER_NAME, A.UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE, A.ITEM_QTY, A.REQ_USER_NAME, A.REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME, A.REQ_USER_TEL_NO, A.AGENT_NAME, A.AGENT_USER_NAME, A.AGENT_TEL_NO, A.KEP_USER_NAME, A.SPECIFICATION, A.ORIGIN_NAME, A.AGENT_PRICE, A.UNIT_MEASURE, A.BS_NO, A.KEP_USER_ID, CASE WHEN A.STATUS = 'D' THEN '09' -- 취소 WHEN B.INV_NO IS NULL THEN '01' -- 요청 WHEN B.INV_NO IS NOT NULL AND (A.GR_QTY = 0 OR A.GR_QTY IS NULL) AND (A.IV_QTY = 0 OR A.IV_QTY IS NULL) THEN '02' --납품 WHEN A.GR_QTY <> 0 AND (A.IV_QTY = 0 OR A.IV_QTY IS NULL) THEN '03' -- 입고 WHEN A.IV_QTY <> 0 AND (A.DI_QTY = 0 OR A.DI_QTY IS NULL) THEN '04' -- 출고(지시) WHEN A.DI_QTY <> 0 THEN '05' -- STATUS_TEXT, DECODE(A.PROCESS_TYPE,'2','TR','1','재고','3','VMI') AS PROCESS_TEXT, A.GR_QTY, A.IV_QTY, A.DI_QTY, B.INV_QTY, B.ADD_DATE, B.WMS_GR_DATE, B.WMS_GR_QTY, B.WMS_GR_USER_ID, B.WMS_IVK_DATE, TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'DELY' AND CODE = C.DELIVERY_COMPANY ) AS DELIVERY_COMPANY_NAME, C.DELIVERY_NO, A.CONTRACT_NO, A.CONTRACT_SEQ FROM KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_MNG A , KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_IVDT B , KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_WMSIVDT C WHERE 1=1 AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.BS_NO = B.BS_NO AND A.BUYER = C.BUYER(+) AND A.BS_NO = C.BS_NO(+) AND A.PROCESS_TYPE IN ('1','2','3')
AND A.BEFORE_GR_DATE >= #{st_from_date} -- 조회조건 (요청일FR) AND A.BEFORE_GR_DATE <= #{st_to_date} -- 조회조건 (요청일TO)
AND B.ADD_DATE >= #{st_from_date} -- 조회조건 (납품일FR) AND B.ADD_DATE <= #{st_to_date} -- 조회조건 (납품일TO)
AND B.WMS_IVK_DATE >= #{st_from_date} -- 조회조건 (출고지시일FR) AND B.WMS_IVK_DATE <= #{st_to_date} -- 조회조건 (출고지시일TO)
AND C.DELIVERY_DATE >= #{st_from_date} -- 조회조건 (출고일FR) AND C.DELIVERY_DATE <= #{st_to_date} -- 조회조건 (출고일TO)
AND A.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code} -- 조회조건 물류센터
AND A.BS_NO LIKE '%' || #{st_bs_no} || '%'
AND C.INV_NO LIKE '%' || #{st_tran_inv_no} || '%'
AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} -- 조회조건 (고객사)
AND A.AGENT_CODE = #{st_seller_code} -- 조회조건 (협력사)
AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%' || #{st_buyer_item_no} || '%' -- 조회조건 (품목코드)
AND A.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || #{st_description} || '%' -- 조회조건 (품목코드)
AND A.PROCESS_TYPE = #{st_delivery_type} -- 조회조건 (출고구분 1:재고, 2:TR, 3:VMI, 전체:1,2,3)
ORDER BY A.BUYER, A.BS_NO DESC ) X
WHERE X.STATUS = #{st_status_type} -- 조회조건 (진행상태)

/*updateMasterWmPgPrewarhsngWarhsngReg_WMS_IVK_QTY*/
UPDATE KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_IVDT /* 선입고송장상세 */ SET WMS_IVK_QTY = 0 , WMS_IVK_DATE = NULL , WMS_IVK_USER_ID = NULL /* 뮬류센터 송장입력자 */ , BOX_QTY = NULL /* 박스수량 */ , SCHEDULED_DATE = NULL /* 출고예정일 */ , CAR_ID = NULL /* 차량아이디 */ , CAR_NO = NULL /* 차량번호 */ , CAR_PERSON_NAME = NULL /* 기사명 */ , CAR_PERSON_TEL = NULL /* 연락처 */ WHERE 1=1 AND INV_NO = #{INV_NO} AND INV_SEQ = #{INV_SEQ} AND BUYER = #{BUYER_CODE} AND BS_NO = #{BS_NO} AND STATUS <> 'D'

UPDATE KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_WMSIVDT WIDT /* 선입고 물류센터 송장테이블 */ SET WIDT.STATUS = 'C' , WIDT.DELIVERY_DATE = NULL /* DELIVERY_DATE */ , WIDT.DELIVERY_USER_ID = NULL /* DELIVERY_USER_ID */ , WIDT.DELIVERY_QTY = 0 , WIDT.DELIVERY_COMPANY = NULL /* DELIVERY_COMPANY */ , WIDT.DELIVERY_NO = NULL /* DELIVERY_NO */ , WIDT.CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , WIDT.CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MMSS') WHERE 1=1 AND WIDT.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{WAREHOUSE_CODE} AND WIDT.BUYER = #{BUYER_CODE} AND WIDT.INV_NO = #{TRAN_INV_NO} AND WIDT.INV_SEQ = #{TRAN_INV_SEQ} AND WIDT.STATUS <> 'D'

/*updateMasterWmPgPrewarhsngDlvryReg_KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_IVDT*/
